# r8-fixb TEST-RESULTS (2026-11-09). Everything below RAN, where stated. NOT run: any GPU device test, any serving arm,
# any install on a Spark (they need a stopped node / a cluster window). Kit pins: python3 install.py pins -> 20/20 OK.
# Module under test: step/files/.../dsv41_step.py 425c651509c46d05 (r6 = ebe2f7bbebefe916, kept in step/prev/).

== 1. step CPU tests (512S1 Mac Studio, ~/exo-venv313 python 3.13 / torch 2.11.0 CPU, pytest from ~/climb-r1/pydeps)
   cd step && STEP_R5=~/climb-r6/climb-r5 PYTHONPATH=~/climb-r1/pydeps python3 -m pytest -q tests/
   38 passed  (30 r6 tests unchanged against the r8 module + 8 new in tests/test_r8_fixb.py; log tests/run-r8.txt)
   new: r8 vs r6 AST diff == exactly the PACK pairing set (COLEMB, C4, AR map, flags, entry points identical);
        prefill sizes 129..16384 pure pass-through (look + all; decode forwards before/after still pack);
        foreign operand / second first-layer wkv call -> stock; r6 negative control (T-only pairing serves the stored kv
        to a foreign operand); colemb size gate in source; det gate PACK half on the full T lists (sim) -> all gates
        pass, 7/7 mutants caught.

== 2. step device_test.py --cpu-selftest (512S1, same env)              -> SUMMARY: 28 checks (13 mutants), 0 failed
   r6 harness parts (C3a mutant ids at 26 T, PACK=all GEMM harness 60 gates / 20 mutants with the r8 identity fields) +
   det gate on the latest-possible-scheduler simulation (quick T): PACK look/all 9 gates PASS; pack-nowait, pack-cap,
   pack-stale (x2 modes) and pack-r6pair CAUGHT at every T; COLEMB pass-through on CPU ids PASS (engaged gates and
   colemb-side / colemb-cap are GPU-only). Log: step/tests/cpu-selftest-r8.txt

== 3. head (spark-eight, CPU only: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=, nice 19, mandatory venv/CUDA env, no CLUSTER_LOCK on
   spark-one or spark-eight at start; staged in ~/climb-scratch/r8-fixb/, Triton cache deleted, dir removed afterwards)
   tools/mutfit.py (sm_121 compile, no GPU)                                -> ALL PASS   (head/results-r8/mutfit.log)
     every mutant compiles and fits wherever its unmutated kernel fits: 192 (mutant, cfg) pairs
     ksplit (two sequential K-half loops) smem == r6 refine at all 12 refine cfgs (BMX16 BK128/256/512 x s2/3/4:
       8192 .. 98304 B; BMX32/64/128 live: 24576 / 40960 / 73728 B)
     negative control: the round-6 ksplit at the live cfg, BMX 128 = 147456 B > 101376 (reproduces r6-dwA)
   device_test.py --smoke (Triton interpreter, harness only, NOT a gate)  -> ALL PASS (83 s) (head/results-r8/smoke.log)
     incl. the dispatch children (row, tile) and the mutant part; the per-config sweep is numeric -> GPU only
   head CPU tests (512S1 + Mac): test_cfg_guard 54/54, test_dequant ALL PASS, test_refine_logic 216/216,
     test_install 51/51 (run on the Mac in a copy whose ../../climb-r5 resolves, as in climb-r6/)
